Join the group

Work with us.

I'm always glad to hear from prospective Masters students, PhD candidates, and postdoctoral researchers interested in joining the group. Places and funding are competitive, though — the strongest approaches are specific and well-considered, and show that you've engaged with the research described on this site.

Making contact

If something here fits, I welcome an expression of interest. A good first message is brief and specific: tell me which level and which area of the group's work interests you, what funding route you have in mind (or would need), and attach a short CV. The more your approach reflects the information on these pages, the better I can help.
